reviews.x: I was shocked at how much I loved this makeup! I have told my husband several times now how much I love it! It is so natural-looking and doesn't clog my pores. I have naturally oily skin and am prone to acne, so I love that this doesn't make me extra shiny or break out. The colors for the eye shadow are awesome too! I've been having fun mixing and matching them. If you're looking for a natural makeup you want to try without spending a fortune, I highly recommend you try the IQ Natural makeup.

reviews.t: Too shimmery and powdery for older skin
reviews.x: These do no favours for older skin. Most of them are shimmery powders and even with the lightest application following the directions exactly they emphasis wrinkles, even tiny ones, as soon as light hits the skin. The shimmer might look great on young skin though. Also they make your skin look powdery (old) rather than dewy (young). And we all aim for dewy.  Plus point: the brush set is really nice, beautifully presented and good quality.

There are two different shades of beige here for foundation, a very light 'all-purpose' powder, several eyeshadows, a bronzer, a package of travel-size brushes, and sheer setting powder. I would consider the eyeshadows full-size really and each jar is packed to full capacity, but does not have a little plastic cover on top so be careful when opening them! reviews.t: I really like the feel on my skin
reviews.x: This is my first try at using mineral makeup. I really like the feel on my skin. Seems like I have no make up on, but the mineral makeup does even out my skin tone. I had to put the foundation and blush in a little larger container to tap off the excess. Otherwise, there was wasted makeup all over my countertop. I have only been using the makeup for a couple of weeks, but so far I really like it and makeup removal time is some much simpler.

I was so excited to get this product, I have used some of the make-up in the past and this set of make-up is all different from what I have used before, so now I have started using this I really love it, it covers so well and it makes my complication so smooth! I also love the eye shadow's because they all have a little sparkle in them and so it looks so pretty on! I would recommend this product to anyone!

I ordered this after trying Alima Pure and Everyday Minerals, and it works just as well. The price is really good and there seem to be no toxic ingredients! I would definitely order it again. It is true that the brushes are not the most expensive quality, but they work just as fine, I've had no issues so far. Thanks for a great product and a great price!

I love the colors, but I don't use it much due to the mess. I wish they came with a container that helped keep mess down.

reviews.t: ... a lot of reviews before I purchased as I like Bare Minerals
reviews.x: I read a lot of reviews before I purchased as I like Bare Minerals. This is nothing like bare minerals in quality. Do not get if your face breaks out with makeup -  the only kind my face doesnt break out to is bare minerals. Also, the containers are really small and come packed so full that it gets everywhere when you open it. The make up seems to cake on no matter how little you use. I guess it would be okay if you had never tried bare minerals.

I really like using this makeup in the summer. I say summer, because I have very dry skin in the other three seasons and this makeup does not mix well with dry skin. It's not just this brand, all the mineral makeup I have used is very noticeable on my dry skin. Otherwise I love the shades and the feel of this. The set is really nice and quite the bargain.

I was pleasantly surprised with this purchase.  I read the other reviews and thought for the price I would give it a shot.  For it being just a sample set, you get a lot, and I've gotten compliments on how my skin looks glowing. I love how light it feels on my skin and lasts all day. I would definitely recommend buying, especially for the price.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the kit a great value, with a generous amount of makeup for the low price.
Several reviewers praise the natural, smooth, non-cakey coverage that evens out skin tone without clogging pores or making oily skin shiny.
A common complaint is that the containers are too small, causing wasted product and making it hard to dip a brush in.
Some reviewers criticize the brushes and case as cheap or nearly useless.
A few reviewers note the powders are shimmery or heavy and can emphasize wrinkles or leave an unnatural sheen.
